Verse of the Day
The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.
Psalm 19:7
Quote of the Day
"The Savior can and will guide us through every season of life—especially through difficult times."
Elder Clement M. Matswagothata | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
